name: standup
description: /standup shows what you did on the last working day as one card: GitHub commits, PRs opened, merged or reviewed, and Jira tickets you moved, with a button that drafts the standup update

owners.title: Only these GitHub owners
owners.description: Orgs or users whose repos /standup shows, comma separated (e.g. my-company, my-team-org). Empty shows every repo.
